notes: Circumflex decision (batch-wide, TDK Yazım Kılavuzu): kept only where TDK writes it on a common word: Tarihî, dinî, resmî, Hikâye, Mekân. Not used elsewhere. P4 (names plain) untouched.

Imperative convention: polite plural -in for every button/link/aria that is an action (Paylaşın, Kapatın, Kaydedin, Planlayın, Keşfedin, Aramayı kapatın, Hata bildirin); labels and headings are noun phrases.
Candidates kept unchanged (all 9): det.visitInfo, det.hoursNotice, det.hoursNotice.op, det.area, det.bestTime, det.openMaps, det.report, det.faq, CATEGORY_LABELS.nature. No reason to depart.
nav.attractions / crumb.attractions / det.allSights / list.* use 'gezilecek yerler' for 'attractions', matching the published Turkish body text ('gezilecek yerler haritasında').
nav.dining (header) = 'Yeme içme' as the short header form; nav.dine (footer) = 'Restoranlar ve kafeler'. Same page, deliberate length difference for the nine-link row.
nav.food and CATEGORY_LABELS.taste = 'El-Ahsa mutfağı' (Hasawi rendered via the head name El-Ahsa per P2; 'Hasawi' is not in the termbase and would be an English-derived form of الأحسائي).
nav.stores = 'Çevrim içi mağazalar' (TDK form of 'online'); it is long for the header row, measure it. Fallback if it costs a breakpoint: 'Mağazalar' (the Arabic says only المتاجر).
nav.leisure 'Çarşı, park ve çiftlikler' (souq -> çarşı per termbase generic pair); CATEGORY_LABELS.market 'Geleneksel çarşılar' for the ar 'heritage'.
nav.stay / nav.stayShort both 'Konaklama' (already short; the English long/short pair is identical in the pack).
foot.l.privacy 'Politikalar ve koşullar' follows the ar 'السياسات والشروط' literally; 'Gizlilik ve kullanım koşulları' would narrow it.

lang.suggest.text 'Bu sayfanın Türkçesi de var' (not 'available in'): bureaucratic -mektedir style avoided. Note the suggest-bar is built for en/ar homes only; the pack renders it on the Turkish side as the language-of-this-batch string.
search.escHint: starts after the rendered Esc key cap: 'ile kapatın · oklarla gezinin · Enter ile açın'; 'Enter' stays Latin as in the source.
data.dist.about: '~' of the source written as 'yaklaşık' (precedent zh/de/ru all use the word); {n} unchanged.
list.lead uses Arap Körfezi (P5); ar says 'الخليج' with no qualifier, en says Arabian Gulf.
det.unesco: 'bileşenlerinden biri' follows ar (من مكوّنات); precedent zh says 'one of twelve' which neither en nor ar says, not copied.
list.lead source: ar contains an extra clause ('from the heritage places in Al-Ahsa to the museums') that en lacks; Turkish follows en (see source_defects).

termbase_proposals.suffix_vowel: i — gezilecek yerler; yere (common noun, no apostrophe)
termbase_proposals.source: tr-translation/memory/tm.json: published 'gezilecek yerler haritasında' (jabal-al-qarah); TDK gezilecek is a regular participle

termbase_proposals.suffix_vowel: ı — El-Ahsa mutfağı'nda is wrong; as a common phrase: El-Ahsa mutfağında
termbase_proposals.source: derived from El-Ahsa (termbase, P2) + TDK mutfak; no Turkish attestation of a 'Hasawi' form

source_defects.defect: ar has an extra clause not in en ('من الأماكن التراثية في الأحساء إلى متاحف الأحساء'); en is the translation source, the Turkish follows en.

The suggest-bar strings are written from the viewpoint of the page being offered ('available in <this language>'); on a Turkish frame it only makes sense if a Turkish counterpart of a non-Turkish page exists. Not a text defect, flagged for wiring.
